The '''''Vigilance''''' was an [[Etti light cruiser]] that was used by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the ''Vigilance'' and the CSA [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser]] [[Resolute (Invincible-class)|''Resolute'']] captured the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Barabi Run]]'' near to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhilithan]].
